title: A Closed and Common Orbit
author: Becky Chambers
summary: A ship's AI now lives in an illegal humanoid body and tries to learn how to be a person. Alongside it, the story follows Pepper, a young woman raised in a factory, and how she once met the AI's friend.
readIf: you like gentle, character-led science fiction about identity and chosen family.
skipIf: you want battles, tension and big plot twists.
